description: Acquires the public USDA SNAP current-authorized retailer point snapshot and normalizes source-anchored establishment candidates.
retry: Retry transient metadata and query failures with exponential backoff; fail after four attempts.
checkpoint: Acquisition is ordered by ObjectId and artifacts are isolated by run ID; a source edit during paging invalidates the run.
idempotency: The ArcGIS data edit timestamp identifies the source snapshot; normalized IDs derive from USDA Record_ID.
cancellation: Abort active page requests and leave no shared lock; unpublished artifacts stay run-scoped.
retention_profile: Retain immutable public source snapshots and derived records until an approved retention operation removes them.
